entry.title: feat(ga4): attempt-anchored B6 closure, device x error_code split, D2…
entry.content:
feat(ga4): attempt-anchored B6 closure, device x error_code split, D2 false-positive fix

1) B6 口径: add conversion_attempt event at the start of every user-initiated
   conversion (single + batch), so the invariant becomes terminal <= attempt +
   tolerance instead of comparing against file_upload (which is only sent after
   a successful upload, making pre-upload failures look like double counting).
   Pure predicate in scripts/lib/ga-attempt-closure.mjs with self-test; B6 now
   reports UNKNOWN explicitly when attempt is absent (pre-deploy window) instead
   of silently passing. Guarded by tests/ga-attempt-instrumentation.test.ts.

2) R1: new device_error_code module + meta.deviceEngineSplit resolves whether
   the desktop/mobile failure gap is engine-side or pre-upload. Result: overall
   failure rates differ significantly (z=2.95, p=0.003) but engine-side rates do
   not (z=1.07, p=0.285) - desktop fails more on FILE_TOO_LARGE and direct
   upload, not on engine errors. NON_ENGINE_CODES/isEngineFailureCode extracted
   to lib/ga-error-codes.mjs as the single source for G1-G4 consumers.

3) D2: rewrite to remove the zero-failure false positive - missing Part A
   baseline is now UNKNOWN (was PASS), no cross-date fallback, same-caliber
   engine count (previously missed USER_INPUT_CODES), plus a self-consistency
   guard on the Part A detail total.

Also: GA4 event-level gap detection (meta.dayCoverage, closure warnings when a
day is missing) and the Feishu all-green wording now requires BOTH red teams to
be PASS. Report: docs/GA4口径治理三项-2026-11-15.md

entry.title: fix: classify Safari 'Load failed' network error as CONVERSION_UNAVAI…
entry.content:
fix: classify Safari 'Load failed' network error as CONVERSION_UNAVAILABLE

Safari/WebKit throws TypeError('Load failed') on fetch network failure
(Chrome: 'Failed to fetch', Firefox: 'NetworkError...'). It was not
covered by the classifier regex, so Safari network failures collapsed
to UNKNOWN in GA4 (observed 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-14). Add \bload
failed\b (word-anchored to avoid matching 'download failed'). +2 tests.

Also add GA4 residual handling report 2026-11-15.
